neighbours.label: ' being' (and similar existential complements) after 'way of' / 'art of' in abstract, essayistic phrasing
fire: Meditation is less a technique than a quiet way of being with oneself.
For the poet, exile became a permanent way of being in the world.
Her essay explores the art of being present in ordinary moments.
The monks practised a simple way of being that rejected possessions.
His lectures on the art of being human drew large crowds.
Indigenous philosophy offers another way of being on the land.
The novel portrays loneliness as a modern way of being.
She wrote a short guide to the art of being idle.
quiet: Meditation is less a technique than a quiet habit practised each morning.
For the poet, exile became a permanent source of new material.
Her essay explores the history of clocks in ordinary homes.
The monks practised a simple diet that rejected meat.
His lectures on the history of medicine drew large crowds.
Indigenous farmers offer another method of rotating crops.
The novel portrays loneliness as a modern epidemic.
She wrote a short guide to the birds of the coast.
